content.text: – TSH receptor antibodies cause ↑ thyroid hormone synthesis, release, & thyroid gland growth worse w/ stress (pregnancy, illness)
: potentially fatal complication of untreated thyrotoxicosis usually
: anxiety, tremors, nervousness, fatigue, weakness, increased sympathetic
: nonpitting, edematous, pink-brown plaques/nodules on skin
thyroid cell destruction by anti-thyroid peroxidase & anti-thyroglobulin antibodies
: extreme form of hypothyroidism usually d/t
MC seen in elderly women in winter
: fatigue, sluggishness, memory loss, depression, ↓ DTR
- often returns to euthyroid when D/C
